system.description: You hold a meagre ration up to the sky.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it feeds 2d6 people.
outcomes.success: A handful of dry crusts or bitter roots becomes a full day's sustenance for d6 people.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the ration stays as it was.
outcomes.ruin: The ration rots in your hands, and anyone who eats it is Infected. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
